speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Legg-Calvé-Perthes Disease (Left Hip). The X-ray findings of femoral head fragmentation combined with the clinical presentation of a limp and referred knee pain in a 7-year-old male are diagnostic. I recommend initiating a referral to pediatric orthopedics for further management and physical therapy.
